newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Brash puts dampener on NZ shares, mkt ends lower.
newsitem.headline: Brash puts dampener on NZ shares, mkt ends lower.

text.p: * NZ central bank says would prefer firmer conditions
* Higher interest rates, dollar affect equities
* Carter Holt, Telecom results to dictate direction
Price movements at close
LAST CHG * NZSE40 cap index -12.05 at 2,300.20
324 +2 * NZSC cap index +0.18 at 5,021.75
324 -4 * NZMC cap index -6.75 at 1,872.79 344 -11 * Volume NZ$47 million. Futures -5 at 1,155
670 nil * Other movers - -10
New Zealand shares ended weaker on Monday after taking a blow in early trade from a Reserve Bank monetary policy statement that saw short rates and the currency escalate.
The Top-40 Capital Index ended down 12.05 points at 2,300.20 on volume worth NZ$47 million.

Short rates rose 20 basis points to 7.10 percent while the currency's Trade-Weighted Index was closing around 45 basis points higher at 67.89, after the Reserve Bank said it would prefer to see monetary conditions firm towards those assumed in March -- 68.0 on the TWI and 7.5 percent in the 90-days.
Ord Minnett director of equities John Rattray said the market would possibly have weakened on the day without the RBNZ's help but the statement had sealed its fate.
"That was the story of the day really," he said, adding that the statement would probably continue to act as a dampener over the next couple of days.
Also high in brokers' minds are the impending annual results of Carter Holt Harvey on Tuesday and market giant Telecom the following day.
Expectations are not high for CHH, with low commodity prices and higher competition in packaging expected to almost halve its annual profit to NZ$235 million.

"And I guess there is some caution with Telecom, just because of the way recent results have been, and the extent of the extraordinary write-offs for things like the computer 2000 problem and the Australian subsidiary," Rattray said.
Elsewhere in the market, brewer Lion Nathan ended 10 cents weaker at $3.45, after a volatile performance of late.
